# Alex Moraes Tech

Alex Moraes Tech is the professional brand and portfolio of Alexsandro Moraes. The brand may also be searched as Alex Moraes, Alexsandro Moraes Tech, or Alex Tech.

Alex creates professional websites, landing pages, portfolios, internal systems, process automations, and practical digital solutions for companies.

## Website

- URL: https://alexmoraestech.com/
- Language: Portuguese (Brazil)
- Primary audience: companies and professionals that need a website, a custom internal system, process automation, or better organization of operational routines.

## Core Expertise

- Automation of repetitive operational routines
- Internal systems for teams and administrative processes
- Professional and responsive business websites
- Landing pages and professional portfolios
- Website development with React, Vite, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
- Spreadsheet conversion, validation, and import preparation
- XML, PDF, Excel, SQLite, and Python workflows
- File organization, report generation, scheduling, and data standardization

## Portfolio Message

Alex Moraes Tech understands business goals and operational problems, then builds websites, systems, and automations that generate practical outcomes: a stronger digital presence, clearer presentation, less manual work, fewer errors, faster processing, and more reliable routines.

## Search Identity

- Official brand: Alex Moraes Tech
- Professional name: Alexsandro Moraes
- Also known as: Alex Moraes, Alexsandro Moraes Tech, Alex Tech
- Main services: website creation, landing pages, professional portfolios, internal systems, and process automation
- Location: Varzea Paulista, Sao Paulo, Brazil

## Case Study Themes

- SARA: Sistema Auxiliar de Rotinas Automaticas for organizing files, automating transfers, generating reports, scheduling executions, and reducing repetitive effort.
- Conversor Financeiro: automated conversion of financial reports into standardized import spreadsheets.
- Sistema de Estoque: internal stock control interface for visibility, movement tracking, and operational organization.
